title: Competitor
description: A person's master record for one competitor, at <venture>/competitors/<id>.json: a company serving the same customers with an offering that can replace the venture's (Porter 1980). A person owns it. The signal projector may create it once when it is missing, from a signal's organization part, and never writes it again (everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md). What signals say about the competitor sits beside it in competitors/<id>/signals.json, which only the projector writes. Nothing projects yet: that is a later build item.

id.description: The file name, and the subject of the signals about it

stance.description: How the venture stands toward it, in a person's words

created_from.description: The signal the projector created this record from, when a person did not write it first
